## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2006. The issue was that orders-consumer 2.0.1 changed the default HTTP port from 8080 to 9090, but the liveness probe configuration wasn't updated accordingly. This caused all health checks to fail, triggering continuous pod restarts in a CrashLoopBackOff state. The fix is to update the deployment's liveness (and readiness) probe configuration to check port 9090 instead of 8080.
